name: write.irts
title: format of the time in GMT, then formatC of the value at 4 significant digits.

origin.description: format of the time in GMT, then formatC of the value at 4 significant digits.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The series, matrix, or path this function accepts.

origin.details: format of the time in GMT, then formatC of the value at 4 significant digits.
origin.value: The same value tseries 0.10-63 returns for this case, written as one line.
origin.example:
tms <- as.POSIXct(c("1991-01-04 17:00:00", "1991-01-05 09:30:00", "1991-01-06 12:00:00"), tz = "GMT")
tmp <- "/tmp/tseries-write-irts.txt"
write.irts(irts(tms, c(1/3, 1.23, 10)), tmp)
paste(readLines(tmp), collapse = "|")
